function.name: requests_get
function.description: Sends a GET request to the specified URL to retrieve weather data from the Open-Meteo API. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

url.description: URL of the Open-Meteo API endpoint.

headers.description: Headers to include in the request. Each key-value pair represents a header field and its value.

Content-Type.description: The MIME type of the body of the request (used with POST and PUT requests).

Accept.description: Media type(s) that is/are acceptable for the response.

timeout.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for the server to send data before giving up. This is a float type value.

params.description: Query parameters for the GET request.

latitude.description: Latitude of the location, positive for N and negative for S. This is a float type value.

longitude.description: Longitude of the location, positive for E and negative for W. This is a float type value.

elevation.description: Elevation in meters above sea level for the location. The default value represents no elevation downscaling.

auth.description: Authentication tuple for HTTP authentication, in the format (username, password).

cert.description: Path to the SSL client certificate file (.pem). A null value means no client certificate is used.

cookies.description: Dictionary of cookies to send with the request. Each key represents a cookie name.

proxies.description: Dictionary mapping protocol names to the URL of the proxy. Each key-value pair represents a protocol and its proxy URL.

stream.description: If True, the response should be streamed; otherwise, it should be downloaded immediately.

verify.description: Whether to verify the server's TLS certificate.

Below is a quick snapshot of some of the most widely‑publicized festivals that are coming up in the United States.  (All dates are for the 2024 calendar year unless otherwise noted.)  

| Festival | Dates | Location | What It’s About | Quick Highlights |
|----------|-------|----------|-----------------|------------------|
| **South by Southwest (SXSW)** | **March 11–20, 2024** | Austin, TX | Film, music, and interactive media conference & festival | 1,000+ concerts, 200+ film screenings, 2,500+ tech demos |
| **Coachella Valley Music & Arts Festival** | **April 12–14, 2024** | Indio, CA | Multi‑genre music & art festival | 70+ stages, 200+ artists, 100+ art installations |
| **New Orleans Jazz & Heritage Festival** | **May 24–27, 2024** | New Orleans, LA | Jazz, blues, world music, food & crafts | 1,000+ musicians, 200+ food vendors |
| **Burning Man** | **August 28–September 5, 2024** | Black Rock Desert, NV | Art & community event | 70+ art installations, 50+ music stages |
| **Pride Week (NYC Pride)** | **June 26–July 1, 2024** | New York City, NY | LGBTQ+ celebration | 1,000+ events, 200+ performances |
| **Taste of Chicago** | **July 13–15, 2024** | Chicago, IL | Food & music festival | 200+ restaurants, 50+ live bands |
| **Oktoberfest Chicago** | **September 21–October 6, 2024** | Chicago, IL | German beer & culture festival | 200+ breweries, 50+ food stalls |
| **Newport Folk Festival** | **October 18–20, 2024** | Newport, RI | Folk music festival | 200+ musicians, 30+ stages |
| **Christmas in the Park (Chicago)** | **December 1–31, 2024** | Chicago, IL | Holiday lights & entertainment | 200+ holiday displays, 50+ shows |

### How to Find the “Next” Festival

If you’re looking for the very next festival that will happen after today’s date, you can:

1. **Check the calendar above** – the earliest date listed is SXSW (March 11, 2024).  
2. **Use a local event calendar** – many cities publish their own “upcoming events” lists.  
3. **Search online** – a quick Google search for “upcoming festivals in the U.S. 2024” will pull up recent listings.  

Feel free to let me know if you’d like more details on any particular festival (line‑ups, ticket info, travel tips, etc.) or if you’re interested in a specific type of festival (food, music, cultural, etc.).
